name: Permanent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of continuous residence in Saint Lucia, though this period can be significantly reduced in certain circumstances.
Those who have extended their temporary residency for a minimum of 2 years may instead apply for permanent residency through the Ministry of Labour.
requirements.fix_path: Extend temporary residency for at least 2 years.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous residence (5 years) or extended temporary residency (2 years)
Work permit history or property purchase evidence (special ministerial permission required for property purchase)

sources.title: Lexology -- A General Introduction to Immigration Law and Policy in Saint Lucia: permanent residence after 5 years' continuous residence (reducible in certain circumstances) OR after 2 years on extended temporary residency; PR does NOT itself confer the right to work; initial residency requires a work permit or ministerially-permitted property purchase
St. Lucia Business Guide -- Immigration & Visas: corroborates the 5-year continuous-residence PR pathway

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Lucia's initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- no official govt.lc page describing Permanent Residence requirements was located (a general web/site search for one came up empty); both sources are tier 3 (a law firm article and a business guide). IMPORTANT: unlike most other PR statuses modelled this session, Saint Lucia's Permanent Residence explicitly does NOT confer the right to work -- a separate work permit remains required even after achieving PR, per the Lexology source's direct quote. work_rights modelled as 'none' accordingly. citizenship_after_months (84 = 7 years) reflects the Section 8 Naturalisation residence figure (see lc_naturalisation.json) as the nearest onward citizenship pathway, though PR-holding time is not confirmed to count directly toward that 7-year naturalisation clock -- flagged as an inference, not a stated rule.
